name: com.wattanalysis/wattanalysis-data
title: WattAnalysis Data
description: WattAnalysis public data: China energy statistics, prices, tender aggregates, policy registers.

tools.name: list_series
tools.description:
List the public WattAnalysis series (monthly statistics, price series,
    tender price aggregates). Returns one catalog entry per series with its
    id, kind, title, unit/caliber where applicable, coverage period and
    point count. Optional filters: kind ('monthly' | 'price' | 'tender'),
    segment (e.g. 'solar', 'wind', 'coal', 'oil-gas', 'grid', 'end-use'),
    or a free-text query matched against id and title.

kind.description: Filter by series kind: 'monthly' (monthly statistical series), 'price' (public price series) or 'tender' (tender price aggregates). Empty string (default) returns all kinds.
kind.title: Kind

segment.description: Filter by energy segment, e.g. 'solar', 'wind', 'coal', 'oil-gas', 'grid', 'storage', 'hydrogen' or 'end-use'. Applies to monthly series. Empty string (default) returns all segments.
segment.title: Segment

query.description: Free-text filter matched case-insensitively against each series id and title. Empty string (default) disables the text filter.
query.title: Query

tools.name: get_series
tools.description:
Fetch one public series by id (from list_series, e.g. 'nea-cap-solar'
    or 'WA-PRC-28'), with its metadata and records. Optional start/end
    filters (inclusive) match the record period ('YYYY-MM' for monthly
    series, 'YYYY-MM-DD' where the series is dated).

series_id.description: Series id from list_series, e.g. 'nea-cap-solar' (monthly statistics) or 'WA-PRC-28' (price series). Case-insensitive.
series_id.title: Series Id

start.description: Optional inclusive start-period filter: 'YYYY-MM' for monthly series, 'YYYY-MM-DD' where the series is dated. Empty string (default) means no lower bound.
start.title: Start

end.description: Optional inclusive end-period filter, same format as start. Empty string (default) means no upper bound.
end.title: End

tools.name: search_tenders
tools.description:
Search the public energy-storage tender layer: the tender price
    aggregate series (WattAnalysis aggregates of published tender and
    candidate quotes, with sample sizes and method notes). With no query,
    returns all public tender series. Note: record-level tender notices are
    not part of the public layer; this tool serves the published aggregate
    series only.

query.description: Free-text filter matched case-insensitively against the full text of each public tender aggregate series (titles, method notes and data points). Empty string (default) returns all public tender series.
query.title: Query

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description:
List entries in the WattAnalysis policy document register (Chinese
    and trade-partner policy documents, tracked from the primary text).
    Optional free-text query (title, issuer, document number), issue year,
    and a result limit (default 20).

query.description: Free-text filter matched case-insensitively against document register id, document number, title, issuer and domain tags. Empty string (default) disables the text filter.
query.title: Query

year.description: Issue-year filter, e.g. 2025 matches documents whose issue date falls in that year. 0 (default) disables the year filter.
year.title: Year

limit.description: Maximum number of register entries to return. Default 20; values are clamped to the range 1–100.
limit.title: Limit

tools.name: get_document
tools.description:
Fetch the full public record of one policy document by its register
    id (e.g. 'WA-DOC-2025-0101'), including status history fields and the
    measures linked to it.

doc_id.description: Policy document register id from list_documents, e.g. 'WA-DOC-2025-0101'.
doc_id.title: Doc Id

tools.name: list_measures
tools.description:
List trade and policy measures in the WattAnalysis register (tariffs,
    export controls and related measures affecting China's energy supply
    chains). Optional market filter (e.g. 'US', 'EU') and free-text query
    (product, measure type, rate).

market.description: Market filter, e.g. 'US' or 'EU' (case-insensitive). Empty string (default) returns measures for all markets.
market.title: Market

query.description: Free-text filter matched case-insensitively against measure id, product, measure type, rate text, market and HS codes. Empty string (default) disables the text filter.
query.title: Query

limit.description: Maximum number of register entries to return. Default 20; values are clamped to the range 1–100.
limit.title: Limit
